nodes.title: Optional Stuff
widgets_values:
- Only enable the Turbo LoRA if you're using a Raw version of Krea2
- Negative conditioning is super crucial, add (word:-1.0) to prompt to negatively affect the model.
- Use the "Enhancer" as a bypass or a way to jazz up boring image gen seeds.
- Misc Quality Functions are there to mess around with, they may or may not help various gens.

widgets_values: Keep the mech's held weapon exactly as it appears in the source image — the same rifle and howitzer design, proportions, and dark gunmetal-black finish, unchanged in shape, size, and color. Keep the four flying support drones exactly as they appear in the source image, unchanged in design and color. Keep the Jumppacks and backpack of the mech unchanged in shape, and size. Change only the mech's body armor plating — torso, shoulders, arms, and legs — to a red and white color scheme, with a large stylized flame decal painted across the chest plate in orange and yellow. Preserve the original's weathered, worn military finish on the newly recolored armor: matte paint rather than glossy, small scuffs and chips exposing dark metal underneath, faint dirt and grime smudges along the joints and lower legs, and light edge wear on raised panel lines — a red-and-white paint job that's seen real use, not a clean showroom finish.
